hero_title: Lead calmer teams without working longer hours.
hero_sub: I coach new managers and small-business owners through the first hard years of leading people. One-on-one coaching, team workshops and keynote talks.
services_intro: Every engagement starts with a free 20-minute call, so we can both see if it is a fit.

services.name: One-on-one coaching
services.text: Twelve sessions over six months, by video, with short notes after each one.

services.name: Team workshops
services.text: Half-day sessions on feedback, delegation and running meetings people want to attend.

services.name: Keynote talks
services.text: Talks for conferences and company events, from 30 to 60 minutes.

talks_intro: Each talk can be a keynote or a hands-on workshop.

talks.name: The quiet manager
talks.text: Why the calmest person in the room usually leads it, and how to become that person.

talks.name: Feedback that lands
talks.text: A simple way to say the hard thing early, kindly and once.

talks.name: Small teams, big weeks
talks.text: How owner-led teams get through their busiest season without burning out.

talks.name: Meetings worth having
talks.text: Cut meeting time in half without losing the decisions.

book.title: The Quiet Manager
book.subtitle: Leading people without the noise
text: A short, practical book for first-time managers, built from the questions clients bring to coaching.
Each chapter ends with one thing to try on Monday.

about: I spent twelve years managing nursing teams before I started coaching. The hardest part of that job was never the medicine. It was the people work no one trained me for.
Now I help new leaders learn it faster than I did. I work with managers at small companies, clinics and nonprofits across the US, all by video.
contact_text: Book a free intro call, or send a note about coaching, a workshop or a talk.
